prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game VFX animation sprite sheet, a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG. Square canvas 1024x1024, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 256x256 cells, 16 sequential animation frames read left to right then top to bottom. Every frame shares a fixed center at the center of its own cell, identical camera and scale, 18 pixel transparent padding on every edge; no artwork crosses cell boundaries. This is ONE continuous non-looping boss arrival animation, not sixteen unrelated icons. Detailed hand-painted dark fantasy game art with crisp black ink contours, textured material, dimensional painted shading and restrained emissive highlights; strong silhouettes at small size. No text, no numbers, no grid, no cell borders, no UI, no backdrop, no floor, no opaque rectangle, no checkerboard painted into image. Only the animated material effect; do NOT draw the boss or any character. The center becomes empty transparent space as the material ruptures, so the existing game boss can be seen through it. Frames 1-3 gathering and tension, 4-6 rupture, 7-10 outward motion and trailing material, 11-13 breakup, 14-16 sparse dissolving residual particles. Preserve coherent motion and the same individual pieces across consecutive frames. Ivory eggshell wrapped in fine golden-white silk cracks open into two irregular jagged halves, with a few blue-black raven feathers. Feathers unfurl and rotate outward; eggshell fragments tumble away; silk tears into wisps. Cream bone, black-blue feathers, warm gold glints. Frame 1 a small closed silk-wrapped egg at center, frame 5 rupturing shell, frame 8 large open oval center with feathers and jagged shell moving outward, frame 16 only a few tiny drifting feathers.
